title: Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet) (lesson 8)
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y1 lesson 8 (Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet))
intro: Lesson 8: Proud, not showing off; and our worries. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

box.title: Draw a jar. Inside, write or draw one small worry. Outside, write the name of a grown-up you trust (a word or a symbol, no faces).

keywords.def: happy about something good you did
making others feel small to look big
a scared or uneasy feeling inside

questions.q: Your friend reads beautifully. What could you say to them?
Pupil PDF: draw a 'worry jar' and write or draw one small worry to put in it, then the name of a trusted adult (a word or a symbol, no faces).
questions.a: A worry jar with one worry and a trusted adult named.

questions.q: Extend: say one thing you are proud of and say alhamdulillah.
questions.a: For example: 'I tidied my room, alhamdulillah.'

questions.q: You won a race. What is the best thing to say?
options: I'm better than all of you!
questions.a: A) Alhamdulillah!. We thank Allah and stay kind to others.

questions.q: When we feel worried we can ...
Think again: You just learned a new surah! What is a good way to feel happy about it, and what is not?
questions.a: Say alhamdulillah and keep trying; do not make others feel small.
